title: Crisis Comes To Destroy Traditions
text: [Music] tradition is the greatest enemy of change i read the story about samson he was in the desert he meant a thousand philistines they came to kill him samson is standing there in the heat of the sun the sand is hot and he see a thousand men coming to kill him they come with spears and daggers and swords and shields on horses and samson looks around he's in trouble and he sees a white bleached jawbone of a donkey he reaches over picks it up shakes the sand out of it and it has two teeth left in it and samson braces himself and the thousand philistines come he begins to swing that jawbone men fall horses spill over he kept swinging and after a few hours of swinging thousand men lie dead on the sands of the desert and samson is standing there breathing blood all over his body splattered all over his hands and he has in his hands a jawbone bleached white soaked with red blood and samson just saw a miracle he killed a thousand men with a jawbone of a donkey that was impressive to me but what blew my mind was it says one simple statement says and when samson had killed the philistines samson threw away the jawbone that changed my life you see we used things in life that worked they were successful if that was me and you and we used that donkey's jawbone we would have taken that patented it we have taken it registered to the library of congress we've gone to a manufacturer make a prototype we'd have actually made a lot of these jawbones and called them samsomite we've made them a war weapon and we would trade them to other armies and say look it works i proved it these can kill a thousand philistines and we would actually sell them as war weapons follow me carefully we would then trade this jaw bone trade it as a weapon to the future armies we would trade this job why it worked for us look at the word trade trade edition tradition is taking a thing that worked for you and giving it to the next generation samson knew that even though that job won't work for him the anointing left it and he threw it away can you throw away success yes because you could become so preoccupied by your own success it can stop you from going to your next success tradition is frozen success tradition is when which your experience of god was you believe it should be your children's experience also traditions are not bad but they can become useless if the anointing has left them so you got to learn to be willing to change the crisis comes to destroy traditions that's why crisis are good everything that made the american economy work for the past 50 years has been confused the church is the same way many churches are dying right now large churches are slowly dying because the things that they use for the last 20 years are no longer appropriate and god is saying look the anointing has left the jawbone you know the hardest thing in the world to do is to throw away something that worked so change comes to make tradition obsolete this is why much of what you're doing stops working it's not that it wasn't good or it wasn't successful but the anointing has left it and samson was smart enough to know that the anointing left the jawbone and he never tried to sell it to another generation
